title: Sapphire Star Armaments
description: Monster Hunter Weapons brought into Minecraft!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e3e6ef40c3b50b1f226b70f1c514b401b22f016_0.webp)

# Features
The Sapphire Star Armaments arrive with a variety of weapons for you to wield!
It's an expanding roster of weapons at your disposal, so expect your collectin to steadily grow!

## Weapons
Made in the Sapphire Forge, use your ores to create a base weapon, steadily tier it up or use it to create a Mob Weapon

### Insect Glaive
Wield both a Glaive and a Kinsect on your off-hand to unleash it's full potential!
This weapon will allow you to buff yourself through the power of essences and of course, take combat to the skies.

![Essences](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b803c7a580207bf186e4cda7cdda7be714ae726c.png)

![Netherite Glaive and Kinsect on Hand!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6315ce903c902636cc42801777187d582276e75_0.webp)

## Materials
Every mob that has a Mob Weapon will drop special materials, used for both forging and exchanging for points.

![Materials Available at Launch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52837930472b008c08571c8b82b993e1e491815b_0.webp)

# Item Box
Store both your weapons and special materials in your item box. You'll be able to access them anywhere you are as long as you have another item box nearby.

![Item Box](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1959c04d59bf2e270f3274653318d5ffa58f1b8d.png)

# Sapphire Forge
The station for all your forging needs.
Spend your materials and points here to forge the weapons you wish! You may use both your Item Box and Inventory items while forging, no need to manually retrieve them!

![The Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00c1fc276be7120c4ed73cb36ffb9a271e022612_0.webp)

## Dependencies
[Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)

[playerAnimator](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator)

# NOTICE

- I'm currently looking for animators to expand the mod's quality. Currently, the Great Sword is ready, but I'm in need of animators for both the GS actions and future weapons and features. If you know about any animators or are one yourself, please send me a request at @vitosos on Discord or through my socials. Thanks!

# Read me!
Heyo, hope everyone enjoys the mod I've been working on.
This is the third time I work on a mod, but the first to actually reach a state where I can finish it! Therefore, I'm quite new at coding for Fabric, so expect some issues.
I've been learning along AI to code stuff for Minecraft, so it's better for transparency to talk about it, but everything that's art-related (Textures, GUI, Animations, Writing) is solely made by me, I'm a Pixel Art artist so that's my "expertise", except for animations, so they might look a bit janky.

I'd love to keep working on this project! I already have something like a Roadmap for every feature I'd like to add, so any feedback, support and recommendations are more than welcome!

And with that, please enjoy the Sapphire Stars Armaments!
